provenance: aggregate shape of 2 live v1 stores inspected 2026-10-27 (Linux) — key names/types only, no values captured

schema_version.note: store version marker, integer encoded as TEXT — selects this fixture

message_count.note: integer encoded as TEXT; equals the messages row count (see store_checks)

info.note: session metadata as a JSON-encoded string

truncated.note: first observed under meta.schema_version 6 (34/36 v6 stores) — absent from all sampled v1 stores

janitor_managed.note: first observed on a minority of v6 stores (5/36, 2026-10-27) — absent from all sampled v1 stores

notes: The meta key space is open per spec — undeclared keys are tolerated and reported as extra_meta_keys, never contradictions.
Fields listed in the v6 fixture and absent here were first observed under that store version.
